name: stale-prompts-old-round
description: Live pbd436: ~30 prompts of rounds 1-2 still open in round 3 (old action card hand trays, cards-info menus, spent / old trade offers, secret-objective retrieve buttons...): action-card, ui.* and trade prompts had no round / lifetime rule. Fix (bot stale-prompts): the hand tray and the cards-info menu live until a newer copy for the player; trade offers lapse at the end of their round (and when no longer current or a traded card is gone); an undo affordance ends with what it undoes (SO back out of the deck, earlier round...); card preassignments live while the card is held. Here: pinned pbd436 save 220 (round 2, action): Saar gets Coup (pre-assign offer at the action phase start), posts its hand tray twice, Yssaril its cards-info menu, Ral Nel offers Saar a trade, Saar discards a secret objective; the round ends and round 3 starts; Saar posts a fresh tray, offers Ral Nel a trade, discards another secret; rebuild as after a restart. Expected: only the newest tray / menu per player, the round-3 offer and undo and both Coup offers (card still held) are open; the round-2 offer, its sender copy and the round-2 retrieve button are closed and the old tray refuses an answer. Engine only (no legacy equivalent: the original leaves every old button live).
